outcome: postoperative complications (failure/recurrence, urgency, urge incontinence, surgical site infection, dyspareunia)
cohort: 32 female patients diagnosed with vesicovaginal fistula (VVF) who underwent surgical intervention at a tertiary care centre between 2017 and 2022.
finding: Different surgical approaches and fistula characteristics demonstrated varying success rates for VVF closure, with transabdominal and transvesical approaches showing high success, and primary fistulas and interposition flaps associated with improved outcomes, while iatrogenic causes like hysterectomy were the leading VVF etiology.
